explainer_body: Your coach reads your active injuries every time it suggests a session or builds a plan. It follows the pain-monitoring approach used by physios: pain up to 3/10 during activity that settles by the next morning is usually OK, so you can keep training and keep an eye on it. Above that — or if it's worse the next day — your coach shortens, eases or swaps the session for cross-training that doesn't load the sore area, and brings it back gradually.
explainer_disclaimer: This is coaching, not medical advice. See a physio or doctor if you notice:
red_flag_night: Pain at night or at rest
red_flag_gait: Pain that changes how you walk or run
